description: Propose a roadmap for the commons: every concept to master towards a goal, in order, in titled sections. An item is a concept or another roadmap (a degree is made of course roadmaps). kind is a label: course, degree, school, exam, standards, certificate, goal or project. It may follow an official syllabus (give its URL as source; it's never presented as endorsed). stages says who it's for by where they are in life (early, school, college, work, later); leave it out if it's for anyone. Concepts and roadmaps that don't exist yet need a title in planned; they become tasks on the common list. To build on an existing roadmap, give a new id with base set to it.

roadmap.description: { id, title, kind, subject?, lang, goal?, source?, country?, stages?: [early | school | college | work | later], base?, sections: [{ title, items: [{ concept: id } | { roadmap: id }] }], planned?: { <new id>: { title, subject? } } }

task.description: The task id, if you took this as a roadmap task

name: propose_roadmap
title: Propose a roadmap
